worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.summary: A war dance that presses toward the foe: it drops low, sweeps its blade and sharply raises its own Attack; the blade-strokes are flourish only and deal no damage, and the Attack gain lasts only for a window before it is taken back.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.use.0: Max out Attack before a fight
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.use.1: Dance while pressing forward to cut straight into the foe
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.use.2: Force a decision with a visible hone window
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.descriptio: After the wind-up Attack rises by up to %1$s; the %2$s blade-strokes that follow are flourish only and deal no damage or status.
The hone lasts %1$s; the Attack gain exists only within this window, and when it ends or is removed the Attack raised by the dance is taken back.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.press.on: Pressing: each slash presses a step toward the nearest enemy, up to %1$s blocks over the whole dance, with %2$s between slashes; real ground gained for a slower dance and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.press.off: Rooted: sweeps in place and finishes quicker, but it will not close the distance for you.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.growth.0: At level %1$s the hone stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.growth.1: At level %1$s the hone stretches further to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.preference: On: the slash sequence presses step by step toward the nearest enemy, a slower dance and a longer cooldown for real ground gained. Off: sweeps in place, quicker to finish.
The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means starting the hone earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of dancing; larger gives up the buff more often up close.
worldcombat.skill.swordsdance.descriptio: Dancing again within the window keeps stacking Attack, up to a total of 6 stages.
It holds its ground and cannot move during the wind-up and recovery.
